englishSummary.headline: macOS LAPS setup adds lockout timer guidance

     Microsoft Tunnel requires Docker or Podman on the Linux server to provide support for containers. Containers provide a consistent execution environment, health monitoring and proactive remediation, and a clean upgrade experience.
 
+    Encryption at rest is optional, but we strongly recommend configuring your Docker or Podman environment to encrypt files used by Microsoft Tunnel containers. For information about available options, see the documentation for your Linux distribution and container platform.
+
     For information about installing and configuring Docker or Podman, see:
 
     - [Install Docker Engine on CentOS or Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7](https://docs.docker.com/engine/install/centos/).

englishSummary.headline: Microsoft Tunnel documentation adds encryption-at-rest guidance
englishSummary.summary: The prerequisites page now states that encryption at rest is optional but strongly recommended for files used by Microsoft Tunnel containers, with links to Linux distribution and container platform guidance. Documentation metadata was also updated.
englishSummary.adminImpact: Administrators should review available Docker or Podman encryption options and consider configuring them for Microsoft Tunnel container files.
